in_sanskrit.name: Anguj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Garland of Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anguj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anguj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Angu', meaning 'strength'. This name is a symbol of courage and power, evoking images of a strong and resilient individual. Anguj is also associated with the idea of a garland, signifying the gathering and celebration of various virtues and strengths.
